content.text: open ai gave 70 credits to each of us

Got it—those 70 Codex credits are individual, account-bound credits. They can’t be moved into or pooled with your account.

To use the team’s credits, have each teammate run Codex from their own signed-in ChatGPT account and contribute through the shared Git repo: pull, work on an assigned task, commit, and push. You then integrate their commits. This preserves each person’s credit allocation and avoids sharing login credentials.

If the organizers gave your team a shared workspace instead, its admin can assign a shared credit budget—but that must be set up by the organizer/workspace admin.
